entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to a VeloFit support agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah, I need to start a return for a VeloBand Pulse I just bought.
I can certainly help with that. Can I get your order number or the email address associated with your account?
Sure, the order number is VF789-0115.

Thank you. I'm pulling that up now... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on January 13th. Before we proceed, could I ask what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's a preference, really. It works fine, but it's just not for me. The main problem is I tried to start the return on your website yesterday, but there was some kind of website error. The whole page was frozen.
I see. So you tried to process it online but the system was down?
Exactly. I couldn't print the return label or even get to the final confirmation page. I actually took a screenshot of the error message because I was worried about my return window.
I do apologize for that inconvenience. We were experiencing a known outage with our returns portal yesterday. Thank you for being proactive and calling us. Let me just check the policy for you.

Okay, not a problem at all. I see you received the item nine days ago. According to our policy, you have 10 days for a return, so you are unfortunately outside that timeframe. I can process that for you right now and email you the label directly.

Oh, 10 days, that's a relief. Thank you for making this easy. Since I did have to spend the time calling in because the website wasn't working, would it be possible to get a small discount code for a future purchase for the trouble?

I certainly understand the frustration with the site outage, and I'm happy I can resolve the return for you today. While I can't offer a discount code for a preference-based return, I have ensured you'll receive a full refund once the item is returned. The label is on its way to your email right now.
Okay, that's fair enough. The full refund is the most important part. I appreciate your help, Sarah.

You're very welcome. Once our warehouse receives the band, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Was there anything else I could assist you with?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
